## History

John Henry Carter suffered a bite to the back of his neck when he bent too close to a parrot named [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md). Following a violent hail storm, he visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to report that a lightning strike at Mr. Pettifer's house had killed the bird.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041)_

## Quotes

> "Oh, isn’t this terrible, Miss Abernethy? I was sent over by Mr. Pettifer to check whether yous had emerged unscathed."
>
> — John Henry Carter — [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P39](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0039)

> "Yas’m. A bit worse, ma’am. Our place got hit. The lightning brought down the kitchen chimbly, traveled through the flue, overturned Nutmeg’s cage, ripped a hole through the floor, and entered the sullar. Yas’m."
>
> — John Henry Carter — [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P41](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0041)

> "Yas’m. He was hurt pretty bad. He was killed."

## Relationships

### [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-henry-carter--pettifer.md)

John Henry Carter works as a hired helper for Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md). Following a severe hail storm that struck the area, John Henry reported that lightning hit Pettifer's house and killed his pet parrot, [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P18](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0018), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), +2 more_
